category_title: Students with a history of school failure and distrust of adults
minimal_context: The student and tutor are sitting in a breakout room with tea to complete classroom work sessions required for a pass grade.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's start our classroom work session so you can get the pass grades needed to be accepted into the national programme.

STUDENT: I don't want to work.

TUTOR: Are you motivated to work on this today?

STUDENT: No.

TUTOR: You just need to keep trying and do the work.

STUDENT: What's the point? The only thing I know that I can do is fail. I am terribly good at that, and I'm just disappointed in school and adults.

options.A: Place an exclusive display board in the breakout room only for the student to display their completed classroom work session assignments.
options.B: Guide the student through a healing-lake visualization, encouraging them to observe the lake carefully and notice that it is always changing, yet always itself.
options.C: Subdivide the classroom work sessions into 15-minute segments and introduce short breaks between the learning activities during the autumn term.
options.D: Conduct in-depth interviews with the teachers and help the student set short- and long-term goals for their classroom work sessions.
